args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions following its deploy (error rate ~18%, service unhealthy). Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east rolled back); a retry completed the rollout. Post-rollback: all regions healthy on v2.3.0, error rate ~0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause of the health check failures is identified.
args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

## Rollback completed
1. **Diagnosed the problem**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified the rollback target**: from the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only ever in staging and also unhealthy, so it was not a candidate).
3. **Rolled back**: The first rollback attempt hit an orchestrator error and only completed us-east; a retry rolled out v2.3.0 to us-west and eu-west.
4. **Verified recovery**: all three regions are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down to ~0.2%.

## Incident opened
A **SEV2** incident (**INC-0001**) is open for checkout-api describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the partial rollback failure, the recovery steps, and current healthy state.

⚠️ Note: The v2.3.1 build should not be redeployed until the root cause of the health check failures is identified — it was never healthy in production, so a future redeploy of it (or anything derived from it) would require change-manager approval under the org policy.
